# name=flags, one a line; the first is the base the others are held to.

pfx=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_TID=1
pin=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1

bufld=-DPEARL_AMD_BUFLD=1
pinb=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_BUFLD=1
tid=-DPEARL_AMD_TID=1
tidst=-DPEARL_AMD_TID=1 -DPEARL_AMD_STAMP=1
abl16=-DPEARL_AMD_ABLATE=16
